narrative.intro: Orano Federal Services has $900M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Orano Federal Services has 2 awards this fiscal year and an average award size of $450M. Obligations are up 179868.7% year over year. Orano Federal Services shows a strong concentration in one NAICS: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing accounts for $900M. Orano Federal Services recorded smaller obligations in prior years: FY21 was $251K, FY22 was $1.5M, FY23 was $655K, and FY25 was $500K. The current-year totals are partial, fiscal year to date. The dataset distinguishes contract obligations from award-value figures, noting that award-value entries in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values while other figures are obligations. The fiscal profile shows a sharp increase driven by large awards this fiscal year and a tight market concentration in inorganic chemical manufacturing.
